summary.name: Rambox
summary.one_liner: Rambox is a desktop workspace app that combines multiple work apps, web accounts and messaging/email services into one window.
keywords: single app for chat and email
use_cases: Organizing work apps and accounts in one desktop window
Staying focused across multiple daily work tools
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Rambox as a desktop workspace for organizing work apps, accounts and workflows in one place. It is listed in the awesome-mac directory as a messaging and emailing app that combines common web applications into one. The listing marks it as open source, with source code on GitHub under saenzramiro/rambox, and as freeware. The page text itself is mostly cookie consent boilerplate and does not detail specific features, supported services or pricing.
notable: Open source, with code hosted on GitHub (saenzramiro/rambox)
Combines common web apps, messaging and email into one desktop app
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac directory
